criteria.passage: I’d start by collecting a few examples of when people notice the outdated figures and check whether it happens consistently or only under certain conditions.
criteria.rationale: This explicitly describes gathering examples and characterizing when the problem occurs, which establishes a plan to reproduce or characterize the failure.

criteria.passage: I’d also compare what different users see so we can tell whether it’s universal or isolated.
criteria.rationale: This directly compares failing cases across users and distinguishes whether the issue affects everyone or only some users, which is comparison against functioning behavior.

criteria.passage: After that I’d look at the browser requests and the service responses to see which side is showing the old data. That should help us narrow it down
criteria.rationale: This shows using observed evidence from browser and service to determine which component is responsible, explicitly narrowing the plausible causes.
